thread:
Maya (AE): NewLeaf Investments just escalated. Their procurement lead emailed our CFO asking for a written egress IP commitment, BYOK integration details, and a p95 SLA before their board meeting on Friday. They say the POC is on hold until we answer. We need rapid triage.

Omar (SE): Root cause from their network team: intermittent TLS resets to our api endpoint from their office subnet. I ran a quick probe and saw connection resets at TCP level. Could be NAT pool exhaustion or NGFW inspector dropping long-lived TLS sessions.

Omar (SE): Repro commands I ran from their jump:
```
curl -Iv --resolve api.redwood-infer.example:443:52.12.77.99 https://api.redwood-infer.example/health
# observed: TLS handshake completes sometimes, other times reset after 90s
```

Liu (Security): We can provide a BYOK onboarding plan and an attestation letter for key handling. BYOK via AWS KMS & customer HSM is supported. Legal will need to sign an addendum around key audit access. I'll prepare the one-page attestation and the SOC2/pen-test pack. @Nora please start the security questionnaire so we can see exact blocking items.

Diego (Infra): For an SLA on p95 latency, safest short-term is a dedicated sandbox in their region plus static egress IPs. I can spin up a 3-node dedicated pool in eu-central-1 and reserve three static IPs. Cost estimate: approx $7k/day. If we offer credits, propose up to $60k total credit. Also recommend offering a private-link endpoint to avoid public TLS flakiness.

Ruth (Head of Sales): My take: Offer a 30-day dedicated trial with BYOK onboarding support and private-link. Ask for a 12-month commit convertible discount if they sign within 30 days of trial end. Recommend approving up to $60k in credits for this deal. Need revops/legal fast-track for DPA addendum.

Nora (CS): I'll open the questionnaire and ask them to mark which security items are blocking the board decision. I'll also propose a 30-minute CISO call tomorrow to walk through BYOK and network design. I'll assemble a pre-call one-pager.

deploy-bot: deployment 1732106920 created sandbox-dedicated-newleaf-eu-central-1 (3x-gpu). Egress IPs: 52.12.77.99, 52.12.77.100, 52.12.77.101.

Maya (AE): Next actions: 
- @Nora: kickoff questionnaire, schedule CISO call ASAP.
- @Liu: prepare BYOK attestation + list DPA changes.
- @Diego: confirm 14/30 day cost and credit ask; confirm private-link ETA.
- @Ruth: confirm credit cap approval path with revops.

Maya (AE): Question to leadership: approve up to $60k trial credits and expedited DPA addendum review so we can unblock NewLeaf before Friday's board. Need decision within 18 hours or they will freeze POC.

Ruth (Head of Sales): +1 to the plan. If revenue won't approve full credit, what's the minimum credit needed to keep them going? We should offer a fallback: 14-day trial with 40% credit.

Omar (SE): Also recommend sharing a short network troubleshooting checklist for their infra team to try while we get the private-link in place:
```
1) Ensure NAT pool size > 100 concurrent connections
2) Disable deep TLS inspection for traffic to our IPs
3) Allow egress to 52.12.77.99/32, .100/32, .101/32 on ports 443 and 80
```

Maya (AE): I'll loop in Legal and RevOps now. Please flag anything else critical.
